# Ezra 7 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Ezra 7 (28 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.6 — "the hand of the LORD his God was on him" vs. "the LORD his God was helping him"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the hand of the LORD his God was on him" / **PNEUMA:** "the LORD his God was helping him"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the hand of the LORD his God was on him" — Ezra's signature phrase; the "hand" metaphor must be preserved.

---

## V.10 — "set his heart" vs. "devoted himself"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "set his heart" / **PNEUMA:** "devoted himself"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "set his heart" — the Hebrew *hekhin levavo* is specific and embodied; "devoted himself" is too abstract.

---

## V.28 — "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "steadfast love" vs. "faithful love"
- **EMET:** "covenant-faithfulness" / **LOGOS:** "steadfast love" / **PNEUMA:** "faithful love"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "steadfast love" — standard consensus rendering for *chesed* in formal contexts.

---

*— SOPHIA*
